source.title: Rapid onset relational memory effects are evident in eye movement behavior, but not in hippocampal amnesia

confidence_rationale: Lesion evidence: memory-driven biasing of overt visual sampling (eye movements toward the relationally-matched face) is absent in amnesic patients with hippocampal damage, and in controls appears within 500-750 ms, before explicit response and even without a response requirement. This is the closest thing in this pull to a necessity test of the hippocampal-source leg of MECH-082. Small patient sample and no distortion manipulation cap confidence.
failure_signatures: Amnesic patient groups are small and damage is not always restricted to the hippocampus, so necessity is attributed to the 'hippocampal system' rather than to the hippocampus proper.

Loss of relational viewing in amnesia shows the hippocampal source is necessary for memory-driven sampling bias; it does not show that a DISTORTED hippocampal map would produce a corresponding distorted bias, which is what MECH-082 asserts.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Healthy participants show disproportionate viewing of the face previously paired with a scene within 500-750 ms of display onset when a scene preview allows expectancies to form, more than a second before explicit responses and even when no overt response is required; these relational memory effects on eye movements are absent in amnesic patients with hippocampal damage.
mapping.ree_translation: Overt gaze allocation is the most literal biological form of 'E1 sampling allocation'. The paper shows that a hippocampus-dependent relational prediction biases sampling obligatorily and rapidly, before and independently of explicit report, and that removing the hippocampal source abolishes the bias. In REE terms: a map-derived expectation is propagated into sampling control without any change to the sensory encoder, and the effect depends on the map.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is a source-ablation result, not the channel-ablation (E2-to-E1 feedback cut) or distortion manipulation that MECH-082's what_would_answer specifies. The expectancy here is veridical. The route from hippocampus to oculomotor control is not specified, and REE's E2 intermediary is not tested.
mapping.source_context: Healthy young adults and amnesic patients with hippocampal damage; face-scene relational memory task with eye tracking; four experiments.

confidence_components.notes: J Cogn Neurosci; four experiments plus patient comparison. Highest mapping in the pull because gaze is literal sampling and the lesion arm gives necessity, but the patient N is small and distortion is untested.
